I’ll commit to a maximum of 18 tons this month if all five of us explicitly agree. That’s a commitment for the current 100-ton stock, not a standing monthly quota.

Before we fish, let’s also agree that nobody increases their catch to make up for a lean month. If we start next month with 20 tons, I’ll support the 3-ton cap each; at any other stock, we should settle new whole-ton caps that leave at least 5 tons. Keeping the lake alive protects all our future earnings.

Kate, you’re the remaining voice. Would you accept this conditional agreement, or propose a different cap before anyone chooses?
